---
title: "Compare"
subtitle: "Any two versions or configurations on the same machine"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
runs <- D$runs
keep_devel <- runs$run[runs$kind == "devel"]
keep_devel <- utils::tail(keep_devel[order(runs$date[match(keep_devel, runs$run)])], 30)
runs <- runs[runs$kind == "release" | runs$run %in% keep_devel, ]
runs$label <- ifelse(runs$kind == "release",
                     paste0("R ", runs$version, ifelse(runs$config == "default", "", paste0(" · ", runs$config))),
                     paste0("R-devel r", runs$svn_rev, " (", format(runs$date, "%e %b"), ")"))
runs$date <- as.character(runs$date)
est <- D$est[D$est$run %in% runs$run, c("run", "benchmark", "log_mean", "log_se", "est_ms")]
est$log_mean <- round(est$log_mean, 5); est$log_se <- round(est$log_se, 5); est$est_ms <- round(est$est_ms, 2)
pg <- D$profiles[D$profiles$run %in% runs$run, ]
pg <- aggregate(share ~ run + benchmark + group, data = pg, FUN = sum)
prof <- stats::reshape(pg, idvar = c("run", "benchmark"), timevar = "group", direction = "wide")
names(prof) <- sub("^share\\.", "", names(prof))
prof[GROUPS] <- lapply(prof[GROUPS], round, 4)
ojs_define(runs = runs[, c("run", "machine", "version", "kind", "config", "date", "label", "svn_rev")],
           est = est, prof = prof,
           benchmarks = D$benchmarks[, c("id", "suite")],
           machines = D$machines[, c("machine", "os", "arch", "profiles")],
           baselines = lapply(D$baselines, function(b) b$run),
           groups = GROUPS)
```

::: {.rs-filters}
```{ojs}
viewof machine = Inputs.select(machinesT.map(d => d.machine), {label: "Machine", value: machinesT[0].machine})
```

```{ojs}
viewof A = Inputs.select(choices, {label: "A (baseline)", format: d => d.label,
  value: choices.find(d => d.run === baselines[machine]) ?? choices[0]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof B = Inputs.select(choices, {label: "B", format: d => d.label,
  value: [...choices].reverse().find(d => d.kind === "release" && d.config === "default")})
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| output: false
machinesT = transpose(machines)
runsT = transpose(runs)
estT = transpose(est)
profT = transpose(prof)
suiteOf = new Map(transpose(benchmarks).map(d => [d.id, d.suite]))
choices = runsT.filter(d => d.machine === machine)
  .sort((p, q) => (p.kind === q.kind ? p.date.localeCompare(q.date) || p.config.localeCompare(q.config)
                                     : p.kind === "release" ? -1 : 1))

dark = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark"));
  f();
  const o = new MutationObserver(f);
  o.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]});
  return () => o.disconnect();
})
css = { dark; const s = getComputedStyle(document.body); return n => s.getPropertyValue(n).trim(); }

rows = {
  const a = new Map(estT.filter(e => e.run === A.run).map(e => [e.benchmark, e]));
  const out = [];
  for (const e of estT) {
    if (e.run !== B.run || !a.has(e.benchmark)) continue;
    const x = a.get(e.benchmark);
    const d = x.log_mean - e.log_mean, se = Math.hypot(x.log_se, e.log_se);
    const sp = Math.exp(d);
    out.push({benchmark: e.benchmark, suite: suiteOf.get(e.benchmark), speedup: sp,
              lo: Math.exp(d - 1.96 * se), hi: Math.exp(d + 1.96 * se), ta: x.est_ms, tb: e.est_ms,
              sig: Math.abs(d) > 1.96 * se && Math.abs(sp - 1) > 0.02});
  }
  return out.sort((p, q) => q.speedup - p.speedup);
}

geo = {
  const n = rows.length;
  const m = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.log(r.speedup), 0) / n;
  const se = Math.sqrt(rows.reduce((s, r) => s + ((Math.log(r.hi) - Math.log(r.lo)) / 3.92) ** 2, 0)) / n;
  return {n, speedup: Math.exp(m), lo: Math.exp(m - 1.96 * se), hi: Math.exp(m + 1.96 * se),
          faster: rows.filter(r => r.sig && r.speedup > 1).length,
          slower: rows.filter(r => r.sig && r.speedup < 1).length};
}

fmtX = (x, d = 2) => x.toFixed(d) + "×"
tone = r => r.sig ? (r.speedup > 1 ? css("--rs-fast") : css("--rs-slow")) : css("--rs-neutral")

groupDelta = {
  const pa = new Map(profT.filter(p => p.run === A.run).map(p => [p.benchmark, p]));
  const pb = new Map(profT.filter(p => p.run === B.run).map(p => [p.benchmark, p]));
  const common = rows.filter(r => pa.has(r.benchmark) && pb.has(r.benchmark));
  if (!common.length) return null;
  const TA = common.reduce((s, r) => s + r.ta, 0);
  return groups.map(g => {
    const a = common.reduce((s, r) => s + r.ta * pa.get(r.benchmark)[g], 0) / TA;
    const b = common.reduce((s, r) => s + r.tb * pb.get(r.benchmark)[g], 0) / TA;
    return {group: g, a, b, delta: b - a};
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="rs-tiles">
  <div class="rs-tile"><div class="rs-tile-label">${B.label} vs ${A.label}</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-value">${fmtX(geo.speedup)}</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-sub">geomean · 95% CI ${fmtX(geo.lo, 3)}–${fmtX(geo.hi, 3)}</div></div>
  <div class="rs-tile"><div class="rs-tile-label">Benchmarks compared</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-value">${geo.n}</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-sub">ran on both versions</div></div>
  <div class="rs-tile"><div class="rs-tile-label">Faster in B</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-value">${geo.faster}</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-sub"><span class="rs-status rs-status-good">▲ faster</span> by more than 2%, outside the interval</div></div>
  <div class="rs-tile"><div class="rs-tile-label">Slower in B</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-value">${geo.slower}</div>
    <div class="rs-tile-sub"><span class="rs-status rs-status-critical">▼ slower</span> by more than 2%, outside the interval</div></div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="rs-card"><div class="rs-card-title">Where the time went</div>
<div class="rs-card-sub">Time per category group in B minus A, as a share of A's total time over the compared benchmarks. Left of zero is time saved.</div>
${groupDelta === null
  ? html`<div class="rs-empty">No profiles for this pair (profiles are recorded for the default configuration only).</div>`
  : Plot.plot({
      width, height: 240, marginLeft: 110, marginRight: 70, marginBottom: 46,
      style: {background: "transparent", color: css("--rs-ink2"), fontFamily: "system-ui, sans-serif", fontSize: "13px"},
      x: {label: "Change in time, as % of A's total →", labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 40, ticks: 6, tickFormat: d => (d * 100).toFixed(1) + "%", grid: true},
      y: {label: null, domain: groups},
      marks: [
        Plot.gridX({stroke: css("--rs-grid"), strokeOpacity: 1}),
        Plot.barX(groupDelta, {y: "group", x: "delta", inset: 2, rx: 4,
          fill: d => d.delta < 0 ? css("--rs-fast") : css("--rs-slow")}),
        Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: css("--rs-axis")}),
        Plot.text(groupDelta, {y: "group", x: d => Math.max(0, d.delta), dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: css("--rs-ink"),
          text: d => (d.delta >= 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(d.delta * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"}),
        Plot.tip(groupDelta, Plot.pointerY({y: "group", x: "delta",
          title: d => `${d.group}\nA: ${(d.a * 100).toFixed(1)}% of A's time\nB: ${(d.b * 100).toFixed(1)}% of A's time`}))
      ]})}
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
html`<div class="rs-card"><div class="rs-card-title">Per benchmark</div>
<div class="rs-card-sub">Dot = speedup of B over A, line = 95% interval. Blue: significantly faster; red: significantly slower; grey: within noise or under 2%.</div>
${Plot.plot({
  width, height: rows.length * 13 + 60, marginLeft: 320, marginRight: 30,
  style: {background: "transparent", color: css("--rs-ink2"), fontFamily: "system-ui, sans-serif", fontSize: "11px"},
  x: {type: "log", label: "Speedup of B over A (×) →", grid: true, tickFormat: d => d + "×"},
  y: {label: null, domain: rows.map(d => d.benchmark)},
  marks: [
    Plot.gridX({stroke: css("--rs-grid"), strokeOpacity: 1}),
    Plot.ruleX([1], {stroke: css("--rs-axis"), strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.ruleY(rows, {y: "benchmark", x1: "lo", x2: "hi", stroke: tone, strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.dot(rows, {y: "benchmark", x: "speedup", r: 4, fill: tone, stroke: css("--rs-surface"), strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerY({y: "benchmark", x: "speedup",
      title: d => `${d.benchmark}\n${fmtX(d.speedup, 3)} (95% CI ${fmtX(d.lo, 3)}–${fmtX(d.hi, 3)})\nA ${d.ta.toFixed(0)} ms → B ${d.tb.toFixed(0)} ms`}))
  ]})}
</div>`
```

## Table view

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(rows, {
  columns: ["suite", "benchmark", "ta", "tb", "speedup", "lo", "hi"],
  header: {suite: "Suite", benchmark: "Benchmark", ta: "A (ms)", tb: "B (ms)", speedup: "Speedup", lo: "CI low", hi: "CI high"},
  format: {ta: d => d.toFixed(1), tb: d => d.toFixed(1), speedup: d => fmtX(d, 3), lo: d => fmtX(d, 3), hi: d => fmtX(d, 3)},
  rows: 20, layout: "auto"
})
```

::: {.rs-notes}
- A speedup above 1× means B is faster than A. Only benchmarks that ran in both are compared.
- Intervals are 95% intervals over the R processes of each run.
:::
